notes: Shipping-container end doors (rust-red corrugated leaves, 4 lock bars, cam handles, corner castings). Place over a container face, origin bottom-centre on the deck (y 304). open = 4f@70ms: both leaves swing out toward the viewer, revealing the dark interior (opening x3..28, y3..28); play once and hold the last frame, then grunts emerge.

LOW BRANCH hazard_sweep (replaces Mission 1's low_bridge 64x128). Mossy cypress limb coming down from the top-right (trunk off-screen above), drooping elbow with a thick Spanish-moss beard. Origin bottom-centre = row 135 = lowest point the hero's head can touch: beard tips reach row 135 across x~18..80 in every frame. Danger body = bottom 40 px (bark underside y~96..118 + beard). idle = 4f@160ms loop (moss/vines sway; bottom edge constant). Moves right->left at drift speed.

Warning sign on a piling standing in the river: yellow plank 'LOW / BRANCHES / ! v !' (board y14..42) with a hurricane lantern on the post top (flame centre ~(16,6), add a warm glow if desired). Canvas bottom = waterline (ripples on rows 142..143). Place ahead of each branch sweep, like sign_duck.

BAYOU QUEEN's red sternwheel, side view with slight oblique depth (far frame offset +7,-3). Near wheel centre (62,54), bucket-tip radius 49; origin bottom-centre at the lowest bucket tip (row 103). The lower ~16 px go below the waterline (cover with the foam strip). Water cascades off the rising LEFT (aft) side, churn at the lower left. spin = 8f@70ms loop, clockwise (bottom moves left), 11.25 deg/frame = 3/8 of the 30-deg bucket spacing (12 buckets): direction reads clearly, seamless every 90 deg.

Crane hook block on a twin wire rope. ORIGIN TOP-CENTRE (0.5, 0) at the boom tip: the cable leaves the top edge at x7..8. Yellow/black hazard sheave block (y31..46), steel J-hook opening right (y47..55). idle = 6f@140ms loop, slow pendulum (block offset -2,0,+2,+2,0,-2 px).

Regime fuel-cell canister in a steel cage frame, glowing weird4/weird5 through a glass window (glow centre ~(7,9)). Flat top plate (rows 0..1) and base (rows 18..19): stack them directly (16 px pitch horizontally, 20 px vertically). idle = 4f@160ms glow pulse (dim, mid, bright, mid) with rising bubbles; status light at (11,0). Decor.
Red-and-white life ring with grab rope, hung on a peg (peg at (6..7,0)). Wall decor on cabins/rails.

Riverboat name board 'BAYOU QUEEN': gold slab-serif letters on red planks with scroll ends, battered (crack, bullet holes, missing corner chip bottom-left), Regime spiral stencil sprayed over the right scroll end. Two hanging brackets on the top edge at x22..23 and x89..90. Hang on the cabin wall.
Brass ship's bell hanging from an iron wall bracket; the wall plate is on the LEFT edge (x0..1), so place it against a wall to its left (flipX for a wall on the right). Clapper/lanyard at the bottom.

Red channel buoy (squat float, open lattice tower, red lamp) in the river. Origin bottom-centre at the waterline (row 23 = ripple). idle = 2f@400ms: lamp on (centre ~(6,3)) / lamp off with the buoy bobbed up 1 px. Decor in the water; can drift with the background.

Caged bulkhead work lamp for the dark boiler-room passage; hangs from its mounting plate (rows 0..1, mount to a ceiling/beam: with origin bottom-centre, place the sprite bottom 14 px below the ceiling). Bulb centre (4,8) for an additive warm glow. idle = 4f@120ms flicker (bright, mid, bright, dim).
Coil of mooring rope lying on deck, loose end trailing right. Decor.
Three lashed oil drums (steel, rust-brown, steel; hazard diamond on the middle one) in a timber rack on a skid. Decor with a solid look; body given if you want it as cover/platform (top at row 3).

Small searchlight on a yoke and pedestal for the wheelhouse roof, facing RIGHT (flipX to face left). Lens centre ~(13,6) (x13..14, y2..10) for a beam/glow. idle = 2f@600ms (lens bright / slightly dimmer, glint moves).
